question: In Melanoma combination therapy trials, normalize the combination type to standardized labels (e.g., ICI+Chemo, ICI+TKI, ICI+ICI).

steps.desc: Filter Melanoma combination trials and select combination type.
Map free text to combination therapy categories.
steps.prompt: For each row, read Type of combination and emit JSON {NCT, PMID, combination_type} with label in ["ICI+Chemo", "ICI+TKI", "ICI+ICI", "ICI+Other", "Other", "unknown"]. Heuristics: ICI+Chemo if chemotherapy agents are mentioned; ICI+TKI if TKI inhibitors are mentioned; ICI+ICI if multiple ICIs are mentioned. Other if it does not fall into the prior categories. Output JSON objects only—one per input row; no prose.

steps.desc: Validate label set and drop invalid rows.
